meta.description:
Adds elemental stuff to the game. And some physics and biology. And some biscuits, courtesy of reddycute. Classical music too! 
 Music: 
 menu: Passacaglia and Fugue in C minor — J.S. Bach. MIDI by Jürgen Knuth, licensed CC-BY-NC-SA, arranged by alstocras, same license applies 
 launch: 10 Preludes, Op. 23, No. 5 alla marcia in G minor — S. Rachmaninov, arranged by alstocras. 
 land: DSCH Motif — D. Shostakovich, arranged by alstocras 
 editor: Gnossiene No. 1 — E. Satie, arranged by alstocras 
 game1: C minor — alstocras 
 game2: Music for Strings, Percussion, and Celesta — B. Bartok, arranged by alstocras
